verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a project-management SaaS like Shortcut, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hosted, on-prem or downloadable deployment of the core product. The REST API, the locally runnable MCP server and the extra sandbox workspaces are adjacent features or building blocks, not a self-hosted core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
